nameEn: Tanning and dressing of leather; dressing and dyeing of fur
description: This class includes the tanning, dyeing and dressing of hides and skins, and the dressing and dyeing of fur skins.
includes: tanning, dyeing and dressing of hides and skins
manufacture of leather: patent leather, chamois leather
dressing and dyeing of fur skins
excludes: production of hides and skins, see 0110, 0140, 0150
